name: EverMemOS (EverOS)
one_line: LLM-written episodes and facts; LLM decider on the read side.

arch.product.t: Chassis (API, buffer, storage, search) plus the separate EverAlgo algorithm library

arch.truth.t: Markdown + YAML files; LanceDB is a rebuildable index

arch.stores.t: Markdown tree; SQLite buffer, memcell ledger, clusters, cascade queue; LanceDB or Milvus

arch.graphdb.t: None; parent_id pointers and cluster membership only

arch.scope.t: app and project, then owner partition; deprecated rows filtered

write.entry.t: POST /add and /flush under a per-session lock (360 s timeout)

write.receipt.t: Episode file on disk before return; facts, profile and index lag (eventual, about 10-15 s)

write.roles.t: Tool rows dropped in chat mode; facts and profile re-run per user sender

segment.unit.t: LLM boundary detection over the buffer, 'default to merging'

segment.rule.t: Day change, topic change, task done plus new topic, gap over 4 h; hard split at 65,536 tokens or 500 messages

extract.calls.t: 1 boundary per add batch, 1 episode per cell, 1 fact call per user-sender copy (+ profile if on)

extract.facts.t: Atomic facts derived from the episode narrative, not from raw turns

extract.episode.t: LLM-written episode per cell (title, summary, narrative); the retrieved unit

extract.dates.t: 'last Friday (2023-05-12)' dual format with UTC labels

extract.neighbours.t: Buffer tail carries context across calls

extract.failure.t: Boundary retries, 3-tier summary repair; silent decider fallback on read

graph.communities.t: Embedding clusters (cosine 0.65 within 7 days), no LLM

time.fields.t: One timestamp per row; foresight has its own window

time.update.t: None for facts; profile has add/update/delete; weekly re-merge (off)

derive.profile.t: Profile operations (add/update/delete/none), caps 60 items; off in the benchmark

derive.background.t: OME strategies, cascade daemon, weekly reflection cron

index.lexical.t: BM25 over app-tokenised columns, OR mode

read.rewrite.t: Sub-queries from the agentic or decider loop

read.legs.t: BM25 + vector on episodes; facts attached by parent; fact MaxSim in agentic

read.temporal.t: Timestamp filters; date checks inside the LLM sufficiency step

rank.fusion.t: RRF then logistic calibration; facts and episodes compete in one score (heap-expand)

rank.rerank.t: Qwen3-Reranker in agentic mode only; net-negative in the published method

rank.agentic.t: llm_multiround decider: 1-3 calls, reads full text of 50+ episodes per round

answer.shape.t: Episode blocks 'subject: episode'; top 20, core first

answer.prompt.t: 7-step chain of thought that encourages inference, up to 32k output tokens

eval.models.t: gpt-4.1-mini answers, gpt-4o-mini judge, separate decider model

eval.rigour.t: Vendor harness; max of runs; internal inconsistencies

cost.write.t: About 3 per closed cell plus a boundary call per batch

cost.read.t: 1-3 decider calls in the published method

trust.provenance.t: parent_id chain fact → episode → memcell; no trust model

keep: LLM-written episodes with dates resolved inside the text
Decider loop with a pinned core and per-sub-query RRF blocks
Profile as guarded operations with item caps
avoid: Facts derived from the narrative, so a dropped detail is lost
Duplicate fact and profile calls per user sender
Silent decider fallback that still reports a complete result

extras.t: Up to 10 predictions per cell with time windows; written but never read
Facts and episodes compete in one calibrated score; a winning fact evicts its parent
Human-editable files with entry-level content-hash diffing

token_economy.t: Episodes replace raw turns as the retrieved unit (about 2.3k tokens for top 10 in the older harness, 8.6k in the cloud run); episode summary capped at about 50 words with a 3-tier repair; the decider reads full text of 50+ candidates per round, so read-side tokens are large.

speed.t: Episode written inline before /add returns; facts, profile and index built in background (OME + cascade daemon, eventual ~10-15 s); per-session locks; boundary detector re-reads the buffer on each add.

locomo.protocol: vendor harness, llm_multiround decider, top-20 episodes, gpt-4.1-mini answers, lenient judge, 1,540 q

source_doc: consolidated from the earlier engine documents
